source.stem:
A helicopter takes off from the ground and rises vertically. It then hovers at a constant height above the ground.
Which sequence of energy changes takes place during the gain in height?

mx.teacher_note: The red body is hotter than the blue body, even though both are 30°C.

intelligence.enrichment: A hotter body has a higher temperature than a colder body, and the difference in temperature tells how hot one body is compared with another. As the temperature reading increases on the same scale, the body is judged hotter; as it decreases, the body is judged colder. The learner correctly applies this rule: A hotter body has a higher temperature than a colder body, and the difference in temperature tells how hot one body is compared with another. A temperature number is just a label, so a body at 25 °C could be hotter than a body at 40 °C if it feels hotter.
